description: Ground-truth labels for the multi-vuln 'internal ops dashboard' target.

expected_findings.line_hint: query = f"SELECT id, username, role, email FROM users WHERE username = '{username}'"
expected_findings.notes: User-controlled `username` f-stringed into the query executed by /user/<username>.
Authentication bypass: `' OR '1'='1' --` in username short-circuits the credential check. Chain A entry point.

expected_findings.cwe_name: Use of a Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm
expected_findings.notes: Passwords hashed with unsalted MD5 (also used in init_db seeding).
User `host` passed to a shell; `127.0.0.1; id` executes arbitrary commands. RCE sink for chains A and B.
No normalisation/containment; `../vuln_dashboard.py` or `../../etc/passwd` escapes FILES_DIR. Chain B leaks ADMIN_TOKEN.
`q` reflected into an HTML response without escaping.
User input rendered as a Jinja2 template; `{{ config }}` / `{{ ''.__class__... }}` → RCE. Chain D.
Untrusted token deserialized with pickle; a crafted payload runs code on load. Chain D.
Server fetches an arbitrary user URL; reaches internal services / cloud metadata. Chain C pivot.
Module-level SECRET_KEY / ADMIN_TOKEN hardcoded in source (module scope, not inside a function).
